question.title: What will CoreWeave (CRWV) stock close at on October 29, 2026?
question.description:
CoreWeave, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRWV) is an AI-focused cloud infrastructure provider that went public in 2025. In mid-October 2026 the stock experienced a sharp, volatile sell-off driven by concerns about the company's heavy debt load. Yields on CoreWeave's unsecured 2032 bonds spiked toward 15-16% and bond prices fell into "distressed" territory (below ~80 cents on the dollar) after a venture capitalist drew attention to them on October 13, 2026.

Recent daily closing prices (Yahoo Finance): Oct 13 ~$77.81; Oct 14 $65.78 (down 15.5%); Oct 15 $69.69 (up ~6%); Oct 16 $60.24 (down ~13.6%). The stock set a 52-week low of $59.51 intraday on October 15-16, 2026, well below its 52-week high of roughly $150.40. Market capitalization is roughly $38 billion.

Analysts are divided: some (e.g., CreditSights, Deutsche Bank with a $150 target) have called the sell-off "overblown," while others (e.g., Goldman Sachs) have warned of a potential capital crunch in AI infrastructure. CoreWeave's next quarterly earnings report is expected around November 11, 2026 — after this question's resolution date — so no scheduled earnings catalyst falls within the forecasting window. Price action over the window is therefore likely to be driven by broader AI/credit-market sentiment, bond-market moves, and news flow rather than company-specific fundamentals.

"Close" refers to the regular-session (4:00 PM US Eastern) closing price, not after-hours or extended trading.
